analysis_summaries: The repository processes video frames for people detection using a COCO-pretrained YOLO11s ONNX model. Each frame is letterboxed to 640×640, converted to RGB, and normalized before inference. The decoder filters and suppresses overlapping predictions to produce labeled bounding boxes, including the COCO person class. The application also tracks detections and evaluates tracked people against zones, producing zone-status output.

advice.text: At the camera: an IR light or IR-cut switch; for light that is always low, fix exposure and gain and turn off exposure priority.
At the camera: keep auto-exposure on with a capped maximum and exposure priority off; never lock exposure.

evidence: Brightness changes a lot: the median runs from 0.00 in the darkest moment to 0.44 in the brightest.
About 33% of the moments looked at are dark (median under 0.22).
The view holds still between frames, so the camera looks fixed.

special_algorithms.description: Track each detected person with persistent IDs.
special_algorithms.name: person tracking

special_algorithms.description: Detect each tracked person's entry into and exit from an editable restricted-zone polygon by boundary crossing. Configure the polygon over the clearly visible restricted-access area, such as a marked or barricaded zone; if none is visible, use a clearly defined area near restricted machinery or a safety barrier. Keep the polygon editable for adjustment during testing. Record each event with the person's persistent tracking ID, timestamp, and evidence frame.
special_algorithms.name: restricted-zone entry/exit events

parameters.zone_definition: Editable polygon over the clearly visible marked or barricaded restricted-access area; if none is visible, use a clearly defined area near restricted machinery or a safety barrier.

special_algorithms.description: Detect prolonged presence after a person remains within the restricted zone for 30 seconds. Assign CRITICAL severity when the threshold is reached.
special_algorithms.name: prolonged-presence events

special_algorithms.description: Detect a repeat-entry event when a person enters the restricted zone 3 times within a 60-second window. Assign HIGH severity.
special_algorithms.name: repeat-entry events

special_algorithms.description: Generate structured JSON incident records containing timestamp, track ID, event type, confidence, severity, and evidence references including an evidence frame. Severity mapping: restricted-zone entry = HIGH; normal exit = LOW; prolonged presence beyond the configured threshold = CRITICAL; repeat entry within 60 seconds = HIGH; PPE violations = HIGH only when detected by a compatible PPE model. Include measured FPS, inference latency, and processing time in the JSON output.
special_algorithms.name: timestamped incident records

special_algorithms.description: Annotate the video with person bounding boxes, persistent tracking IDs, the restricted-zone boundary, dwell timers, and incident labels. Show PPE violations only when detected by a compatible PPE model; do not infer them from person detections.
special_algorithms.name: safety incident video annotation

special_algorithms.description: Measure and report FPS, inference latency, and processing time in the structured JSON output.
special_algorithms.name: runtime performance metrics

special_algorithms.condition: Strength ramps from 0 at median luma 0.30 to full at 0.15; frames brighter than 0.30 pass through untouched.
special_algorithms.description: Local contrast, without blowing out bright areas. Added because input1 is dark at night and changes between daylight and dark. The corrected picture is also what the saved video shows.
special_algorithms.name: CLAHE
